name: Fall Down ~Ochita Tenshi no Monogatari~
original_name: Fall Down ～堕ちた天使の物語～
source:
Main character is forced to live a haunted life in a certain mansion. One day he meet a mysterious girl who suddenly comes down from the sky. The girl does not remember anything. They start to live together in the mansion to find their true self.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公被迫在某座宅邸里过着闹鬼般的生活。某天，一个神秘女孩突然从天而降。女孩失去了所有记忆，于是两人开始共同生活在宅邸中，寻找真正的自己。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
